AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Integrated Farming? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Integrated Farming.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Integrated Farming.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Integrated Farming.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

8. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Storage of Crop Produce? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Storage of Crop Produce.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Storage of Crop Produce.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Storage of Crop Produce.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Storage of Crop Produce.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Animal Feed: Hay? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Leftover Food? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Leftover Food.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Leftover Food.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Leftover Food.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Leftover Food.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Grafting in Plants 13 4.2 Homemade Sun Dryer 13 Total Number of Lessons 120 Note and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
